title: Verification Workflow Protocol
description: Protocol schema for a plan-code-verify loop workflow with configurable phases, tasks, and loops.

phases.description: Major phases in execution order. Extensible: add more phases (e.g. 'deploy') as needed.

tasks.description: All tasks across all phases, in execution order.

loops.description: Global loop configurations. Each loop can cross phases. Optional.

context.description: Runtime context. Populated by the engine during execution, not in declarations.

Phase.description: A major phase (e.g. plan, code, verify).

name.description: Phase identifier. Not a fixed enum — extensible to support future phases like 'deploy'.

tasks.description: Task names belonging to this phase, in execution order.

Task.description: A concrete task (minor phase). The core protocol unit.

name.description: Globally unique task identifier. Combined with 'phase' uniquely identifies the task.

phase.description: The major phase this task belongs to.

depends_on.description: Predecessor task names. Tasks execute serially; depends_on declares explicit ordering.

input.description: JSON Schema describing the input contract. Optional. If the handler is a skill, the skill's own SKILL.md may declare this; workflow.json may omit it and trust the skill.

output.description: JSON Schema describing the output contract. Optional. Same self-contained rule as input.

started_at.description: Runtime. Timestamp of first execution attempt.

finished_at.description: Runtime. Timestamp of last execution attempt completion.

history.description: Runtime. Execution history, one Attempt per run. Loop re-runs append; never overwrite.

Handler.description: The execution body of a task.

type.description: skill = a sub-skill under skills/, executed by the Agent reading its SKILL.md prompt. script = an external script executed via bash.

ref.description: Relative path from the verification-workflow skill root. For skill type: e.g. 'skills/requirement_clarification'. For script type: e.g. 'scripts/run_test.py'.

Attempt.description: A single execution record of a task.

attempt.description: Attempt number, starting from 1. Increments on loop re-runs.

status.description: Execution outcome. Only these two states.

output.description: Unified output envelope: { data, passed? }. data is the real payload (any structure). passed is optional, only for verdict-type tasks that drive loops.

data.description: The actual payload. Structure defined by the task's output schema.

passed.description: Optional verdict flag. When false and a loop references this field, the loop triggers.

Loop.description: A loop/backtrack configuration. Lives at the Workflow level (not Phase), since loops can cross phases.

trigger_task.description: Task name whose output is checked for the loop condition.

trigger_field.description: Dotted path into the trigger task's last Attempt output. e.g. 'output.passed'.

trigger_when.description: The value that triggers the loop when the field equals this. Typically false for boolean fields. Type matches the field's type.

target_task.description: Task name to jump back to when the loop triggers.

max_iterations.description: Maximum loop iterations before terminating the workflow.

Context.description: Runtime execution context. Populated by the engine.

current_phase.description: The phase of the task currently being executed.

current_task.description: The task currently being executed, or null if finished.

loop_counts.description: Map of loop_key -> count of times triggered. Key format: '<trigger_task>→<target_task>'.
